items.topic: ExceptionUtils / GenericOperationErrorException are not platform classes
items.claim: Docs teach ExceptionUtils.createBusinessException/createValidationException and GenericOperationErrorException as platform API (error-handling-guide, interceptors, internationalization-guide).
items.fact: No source or template in judo-ng defines them (only doc references). In Rackinspect they are project code (common/.../utils/ExceptionUtils.java) wrapping generated fault exceptions from the project's own fault TOs (BusinessError -> BusinessErrorException, GenericOperationError -> GenericOperationErrorException, 422). Label as example project code to copy.

items.topic: Docs give three contradictory answers for business rule violation
items.claim: Official docs: modeled fault 422; catalog: GenericOperationErrorException 500; template: ValidationException with ERR_ code 400. Catalog interceptor examples throw raw RuntimeException (user sees 500).
items.fact: Two distinct kinds: platform errors (ValidationException 400, AccessDeniedException 403, AuthenticationRequiredException 401, NotFoundException 404; unchecked ClientException, payload list of ValidationResult{code,level,location,details}) vs modeled faults (generated checked <Fault>Exception, 422 + X-Fault header = fault FQN). Field/input problem -> ValidationException; business rule -> modeled fault. Never RuntimeException for user-facing errors.

items.topic: Generated frontend error handling matrix (400/422/401/403/404/500)
items.fact: utilities/error-handling.ts.hbs useErrorHandler: 400 -> toast judo.error.validation-failed + inline errors only if errorList[0].location exists; 422 -> only first key of body, opens OperationFaultDialog (title judo.error.error, per-field text faults.<fqn>.<attr> default raw attr); detection by status only, X-Fault header never read; 401 clears storage and reloads (toast never seen); 403/404/500 toasts; else error.unknown. Fault i18n key faults.<faultPrefix>.<faultObjectKey>.<attribute>. Only 3 validation codes translated by default; others fall back to raw code.

items.topic: Frontend 400 handler crashes when a later ValidationResult has null location
items.fact: If first error has location but a later one is null, error.location.split/startsWith throws (error-handling.ts.hbs:58,183,241). Expected: guard null location. Also errors with no location only produce generic toast (message dropped); location matching no field is stored but never rendered.

items.topic: BusinessException never passes throwable to super -> getCause() always null
items.fact: BusinessException (Lombok @AllArgsConstructor) stores throwable field but calls super() with no args; DefaultDispatcher.java:768 uses e.getCause() so cause is always null and mapper cause output never populated. Fix: initCause(throwable) or use getThrowable().

items.topic: Guice defaults leak stack traces: returnRuntimeExceptions and includeBusinessCause default true
items.fact: JudoCxfModuleConfiguration.java:31,33 default both true under Guice, so a 500 returns details.exception full stack trace and BusinessException cause; OSGi/Karaf (RuntimeExceptionMapperComponent:44,47; CxfActivator:73,76) default false. Property names returnRuntimeExceptions / includeBusinessCause.

items.topic: Interceptors run only for built-in operations, not custom/script operations
items.claim: Interface Javadoc: supports script operations and SDK implementations; empty getOperations means all operation calls intercepted.
items.fact: OperationCallInterceptors fire only on built-in behaviour operations (create, update, delete, list, refresh, set/add/remove reference, range, getTemplate, export, validate). Custom (SDK), MAPPED and script operations never hit interceptors (all 20 call sites in behaviours/*Call.java; DefaultDispatcher.java:716-737). Guards for custom ops must be inside each *CustomImplementation. Javadoc is wrong too.

items.topic: Interceptor async path swallows exceptions; async postCall calls preCall; terminateOnException unused
items.fact: Async interceptors swallow every exception and run outside the transaction; async postCall path calls preCall (CallInterceptorUtil.java:81); terminateOnException() declared but never read, every sync exception stops the call. Sync interceptors run inside the operation transaction so exception rolls back.

items.topic: Interceptors cannot throw the generated fault; wrap in InterceptorCallBusinessException
items.fact: preCall/postCall declare throws InterceptorCallBusinessException only; <Fault>Exception is checked so it won't compile. Use new InterceptorCallBusinessException(type, errorCode, Map details, cause, locale): dispatcher converts to BusinessException -> 422 + X-Fault header; frontend fault dialog translates details by faults.<type>.<attribute>; runs in the operation transaction (rollback). Recommended: type = modeled fault FQN (Rackinspect uses guard name, so no translation matches and it had to override frontend). type/details not validated against model (typo falls back to raw attribute names); null details NPEs in mapper.

items.topic: Custom operation must declare <faults> in model or SDK lacks throws clause
items.fact: A custom-implemented operation needs an explicit fault parameter (faults relation targeting a fault transfer object); without it generated SDK omits `throws <Fault>Exception` and Maven fails 'not compatible with throws clause'. Also an operation whose output DTO matches the action-container view root breaks frontend generator (non-existent *OutputView): drop output / make void.

items.topic: Business errors best practice from Rackinspect (one general BusinessError fault)
items.fact: Model one general BusinessError fault TO (code String, message String, required) and declare it on every operation that can fail (141 ops). Custom ops throw via project factory ExceptionUtils.createBusinessErrorException(code, i18nMessage) (362 call sites), never `new` exception inline; codes are string constants (TicketingGuards), messages from i18n (RackInspectI18n). Field errors: ValidationException with attribute name as location. Non-attribute errors -> BusinessError, never location-less ValidationResult. Readiness/multi-problem checks return a result list (FaultRegistryValidationResult) instead of throwing (commit 8cb4f0b). Bulk ops use dedicated fault (FaultRegistryUploadError) to keep per-row errors. Wrap external-system failures into BusinessError and log cause.

items.topic: Pitfalls in Rackinspect error handling (anti-patterns)
items.fact: Avoid: catch(Exception) -> RuntimeException(e) for Keycloak/PDF/exchange-rate (user sees 500); catch GenericOperationErrorException -> RuntimeException (UserRolesChangeInterceptor:73, UserManagementServiceImpl:208); swallowing cause (WriteGuardSupport:119 turns DB failure into 'forbidden'; UserManagementServiceImpl:196 allowed=false no log); IllegalStateException for business invariants (500); two fault types for same job (GenericOperationError vs BusinessError).

items.topic: Custom frontend 422 override replaces fault dialog
items.fact: Rackinspect custom/hooks/register-error-handler-interceptor.ts intercepts every 422 and shows a 3s snack with data[firstKey].message, bypassing faults.* dialog (batch dialog useCRUDDialog still uses dialog). 400 intercepted only when operation field validation setter is found; location-less validation errors dropped (test asserts MISSING_IDENTIFIER_OF_BOUND_OPERATION case).

items.topic: Rackinspect INTERCEPTORS.md contradicts code
items.claim: L682 says ElementFaultUpdateInterceptor throws ValidationException; L70/175 UserRolesChange throws IllegalStateException; L845 createBusinessException returns GenericOperationErrorException; L834 utils path.
items.fact: Code: ElementFaultUpdateInterceptor catches BusinessErrorException and rethrows IBCE; ExceptionUtils has createBusinessErrorException->BusinessErrorException and lives in common module not interceptors.

items.topic: Write guards must live in custom operations; range interceptors only on _getRangeReference
items.fact: Custom and MAPPED ops (User.toggleActive, createUser, resendInvitation) bypass interceptors; range interceptors only fire on _getRangeReference* not plain list ops; multiple interceptors for same operation see each other's in-place payload mutations, return last-non-null-wins; range interceptors are the security boundary for rangeType=ANY lean TOs; model min/max range bounds are UI-only.

items.topic: Enum query<Attribute>() always throws; derived attribute via inherited member lacks JOIN
items.fact: Known bugs in generated DAO: query<Attribute>() on enumeration attribute throws (ordinal cast, workaround read via DTO or <Enum>.getByOrdinal); derived attribute navigating through inherited member produces query missing JOIN. Set<Relation>(null) semantics corrected: set needs object, unset clears; filter 'not set' via JQL !isUndefined(); CRUD only on mapped non-abstract types.

items.topic: judo-model-cli recipe for building a fragment from Sandbox
items.fact: java -jar judo-model-cli-*-standalone.jar -q -m Sandbox.model <cmd>. create -t <Type> -n <name> --ns <parentFqn> [-s key=value] [--brief]; parents must exist (create Package Sandbox::bp then Sandbox::bp::<id>); --schema shows fields (EntityType: superTypes,name,abstract,...; DataMember: dataType ref required, memberType STORED|DERIVED|MAPPED|TRANSIENT, required/identifier when STORED). Primitives under Sandbox::types (e.g. Sandbox::types::Timestamp, String). Commands: query, graphql, create, update, delete, move, relocate, fill, split, mermaid, save, merge, discard, validate, transform, server. CLI startup ~0.4s. `status` shows clean/unsaved.
